title: "OSCC cytokine study: bulk RNA-seq analysis"
author: "Minh Phuong Dong"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

Differential expression of IL-10 and TNF-alpha groups, batch diagnostics,
gene-set enrichment, and expression visualization in 103 OSCC tumors.
Inputs are `gene_counts_103_samples.csv` and `cytokineRNAseq.csv`.
Group code 1 is the reference and code 2 is the comparison. The metadata
codebook must define their biological meanings and concentration cutoffs.

Genes require at least 10 counts in round(0.9 * sample count) samples.
DEGs use adjusted P < 0.05. Enrichment methods
and plotting limits are specified in the functions below.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load the study counts and combined metadata

```{r inputs}
# Count matrix: first column is gene_id (Ensembl ID|gene symbol).
countData_ref <- read.csv("gene_counts_103_samples.csv", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  tidyr::separate(gene_id, into = c("ensembl", "gene_symbol"), sep = "\\|",
                  extra = "merge", fill = "right")
countData <- countData_ref %>%
  column_to_rownames("ensembl") %>%
  dplyr::select(-gene_symbol)

# One combined table supplies the clinical covariates and cytokine groups.
colData_cytokine <- read.csv("cytokineRNAseq.csv", row.names = "sample_id")
fct_vars <- c("IL10_roc", "TNFa_roc", "batch", "PS")
colData_cytokine[fct_vars] <- lapply(colData_cytokine[fct_vars], as.factor)
rm(fct_vars)

# Use the study count-matrix samples, in the same order in both objects.
# Extra rows from other studies in the metadata are not analyzed.
stopifnot(all(colnames(countData) %in% rownames(colData_cytokine)))
colData_cytokine <- colData_cytokine[colnames(countData), , drop = FALSE]
colData_cytokine$id <- rownames(colData_cytokine)
countData_cytokine <- countData[, colData_cytokine$id, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(countData_cytokine), rownames(colData_cytokine)))

# Batch 2 versus other batches.
colData_cytokine$batch2 <- factor(
  ifelse(as.character(colData_cytokine$batch) == "2", 2L, 1L)
)
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Differential expression function

```{r deg-function}
# Create function for DEG
DEG <- function(countData, colData, design, condition, ref, value) {
  
  ddsMat <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countData,
                              colData = colData, 
                              design = design)
# filter to keep 10 counts and above in at least 90% of samples
  ddsMat_Filtered <-
    rowSums(counts(ddsMat)>=10) >= round(ncol(ddsMat)*0.9)

  dds <- ddsMat[ddsMat_Filtered,]

# Ensure condition is a factor and set reference level
  dds[[condition]] <- relevel(dds[[condition]], ref = ref)

# Run DESeq
  deseq <- DESeq(dds, parallel = T)
  
  df <- results(deseq) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  df$ensembl = rownames(df)
  
  df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    countData_ref %>% dplyr::select(ensembl, gene_symbol),
    by = "ensembl"
  )

#sig difference
  df_sig <- 
    df %>% 
    filter(padj < value)
  
# Normalize and transform the data in the `DESeqDataSet` object
  dds_norm <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

    return(list(dds_norm = dds_norm, deseq = deseq, df = df, df_sig = df_sig))
}
```

# ORA and GSEA function

```{r ora-function}
#Create function for GO and KEGG
ORA <- function(DEG, p, log2FC) {
# Prepare df with ENTREZID for ORA 
deseq <- EnrichmentBrowser::idMap(DEG$deseq, org = "hsa", from = "ENSEMBL", to = "ENTREZID")

# Add ENTREZID as a column (rownames are ENTREZIDs after idMap)
df <- results(deseq) %>% as.data.frame()
df$entrezid = rownames(df)

# Filter significant DEGs 
df_sig <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(padj < p & (log2FoldChange >  log2FC | log2FoldChange < -log2FC))

df_sig_up <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(padj < p & log2FoldChange > log2FC)

df_sig_down <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(padj < p & log2FoldChange < -log2FC)

# ORA
## ORA GO enrichment analysis

GO <- enrichGO(gene = df_sig$entrezid,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                ont = "ALL", readable = T)

GOup <- enrichGO(gene = df_sig_up$entrezid,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType = "ENTREZID",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                ont = "ALL", readable = T)

GOdown <- enrichGO(gene = df_sig_down$entrezid,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                 keyType = "ENTREZID",
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                ont = "ALL", readable = T)

## ORA KEGG enrichment analysis
KEGG <- enrichKEGG(gene = df_sig$entrezid, 
                    organism = "hsa",
                    keyType = "kegg",
                    pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                    qvalueCutoff = 0.2)

KEGGup <- enrichKEGG(gene = df_sig_up$entrezid, 
                    organism = "hsa",
                    keyType = "kegg",
                    pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                    qvalueCutoff = 0.2)

KEGGdown <- enrichKEGG(gene = df_sig_down$entrezid, 
                    organism = "hsa",
                    keyType = "kegg",
                    pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                    qvalueCutoff = 0.2)

## ORA reactome enrichment analysis
reactome <- enrichPathway(gene=df_sig$entrezid,
                          pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                          readable=TRUE)

reactomeup <- enrichPathway(gene=df_sig_up$entrezid,
                          pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                          readable=TRUE)

reactomedown <- enrichPathway(gene=df_sig_down$entrezid,
                          pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                          readable=TRUE)

 #GSEA

##prepare the gene list
gene_list <- df$log2FoldChange
##name the vector
names(gene_list) <-df$entrezid

##omit the NA values
gene_list <- na.omit(gene_list)

##sort the list in decreasing order
gene_list = sort(gene_list, decreasing =TRUE)

gene_list_up <- gene_list[gene_list >  log2FC]

gene_list_down <- gene_list[gene_list < -log2FC]

##GSEA in Clusterprofiles
GSEA <- gseGO(geneList = gene_list,
      ont ="ALL",
      minGSSize = 15, 
      maxGSSize = 1000, 
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      nPermSimple = 100000,
      verbose = TRUE, 
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
      pAdjustMethod = "none")

##MSig DB
fgh <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_h, 
             stats = gene_list, 
             minSize = 15, 
             maxSize = 1000, 
             eps = 0.0)

fghup <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_h, 
               stats = gene_list_up, 
               minSize = 15, 
               maxSize = 1000, 
               eps = 0.0, 
               scoreType = "pos")

fghdown <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_h, 
                 stats = gene_list_down, 
                 minSize = 15, 
                 maxSize = 1000, 
                 eps = 0.0, 
                 scoreType = "neg")

fgC2 <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C2, 
              stats = gene_list, 
              minSize = 15, 
              maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0)

fgC2up <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C2, 
                stats = gene_list_up, 
                minSize = 15, 
                maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0, scoreType = "pos")

fgC2down <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C2, 
                  stats = gene_list_down, 
                  minSize = 15, 
                  maxSize = 1000, 
                  eps = 0.0, scoreType = "neg")

fgC5 <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C5, 
              stats = gene_list, 
              minSize = 15, 
              maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0)

fgC5up <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C5, 
                stats = gene_list_up, 
                minSize = 15, 
                maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0, scoreType = "pos")

fgC5down <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C5, 
                  stats = gene_list_down, 
                  minSize = 15, 
                  maxSize = 1000, 
                  eps = 0.0, scoreType = "neg")

fgC6 <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C6, 
              stats = gene_list, 
              minSize = 15, 
              maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0)

fgC6up <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C6, 
                stats = gene_list_up, 
                minSize = 15, 
                maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0, scoreType = "pos")

fgC6down <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C6, 
                  stats = gene_list_down, 
                  minSize = 15, 
                  maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0, scoreType = "neg")

fgC7 <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C7, 
              stats = gene_list, 
              minSize = 15, maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0)

fgC7up <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C7, 
                stats = gene_list_up, 
                minSize = 15, 
                maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0, scoreType = "pos")

fgC7down <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_C7, 
                  stats = gene_list_down, 
                  minSize = 15, 
                  maxSize = 1000, eps = 0.0, scoreType = "neg")
 return(list(df_sig = df_sig, 
             df_sig_up = df_sig_up, 
             df_sig_down = df_sig_down, 
             GO = GO, 
             GOup = GOup, 
             GOdown = GOdown, 
             KEGG = KEGG, 
             KEGGup = KEGGup, 
             KEGGdown = KEGGdown, 
             reactome = reactome, 
             reactomeup = reactomeup, 
             reactomedown = reactomedown,
             gene_list = gene_list,
             GSEA = GSEA,
             fgh = fgh,
             fghup = fghup,
             fghdown = fghdown,
             fgC2 = fgC2,
             fgC2up = fgC2up,
             fgC2down = fgC2down,
             fgC5 = fgC5,
             fgC5up = fgC5up,
             fgC5down = fgC5down,
             fgC6 = fgC6,
             fgC6up = fgC6up,
             fgC6down = fgC6down,
             fgC7 = fgC7,
             fgC7up = fgC7up,
             fgC7down = fgC7down
             ))
}
```

# Volcano function

```{r volcano-function}
# Volcano plot
volcano <- function (DEG, plottitle, p = 0.05) {
# Add status
 df <- DEG$df %>%
    mutate(Labels = case_when(
      log2FoldChange >= 0 & padj <= p ~ "Up-regulated",
      log2FoldChange < 0 & padj <= p ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"))

# Define plot aesthetics
  cols <- c("Up-regulated" = "red", "Down-regulated" = "blue", "Not significant" = "grey") 
  sizes <- c("Up-regulated" = 1, "Down-regulated" = 1, "Not significant" = 0.5) 
  alphas <- c("Up-regulated" = 0, "Down-regulated" = 0, "Not significant" = 0)

  # Generate plot
plot <- ggplot(df, aes(
      x = log2FoldChange,
      y = -log10(padj),
      fill = Labels
    )) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = subset(df, padj < p),
                              aes(label = gene_symbol),
                              size = 1.5,
                              box.padding=0, fill = NA, label.size = NA, point.padding=1, segment.color="black", show.legend=FALSE, max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "black") + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p), linetype = "dashed") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-5, 5), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + 
    scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + 
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1.5), limits = c(-3, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 4, 2), limits = c(0, 4)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  labs(
    title = plottitle,
    x = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),  # Customize title font size and center alignment
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),            # Customize x-axis label font size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),            # Customize y-axis label font size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),             # Customize legend text size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),             # Customize legend title size
    legend.position = "right"
  )
 return(plot)
}
```

# IL-10: unadjusted model

```{r il10-1}
#DEG
IL10 <- DEG(countData = countData_cytokine,
            colData = colData_cytokine, 
            design = ~ IL10_roc, 
            condition = "IL10_roc",
            ref = "1",
            value = 0.05)
```

```{r il10-2}
# Extract variance-stabilized data
expr <- assay(IL10$dds_norm)

# Compute distance matrix (Euclidean or others)
d <- dist(t(expr))  # transpose: samples are rows

# Prepare metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(IL10$dds_norm))

# Run PERMANOVA / adonis test
adonis2(d ~ batch2 + IL10_roc, data = meta, permutations = 999)
```

```{r il10-3}
#extract the expression matrix
norm_mat <- assay(IL10$dds_norm)
# Run PCA with x = PCA scores (PC1, PC2, …) for each sample
norm_mat_pca_res <- prcomp(t(norm_mat))
# Convert PCA scores to a tibble with sample IDs
norm_mat_pca_df <- norm_mat_pca_res$x %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = "sampleid")
# Add sample metadata to the PCA table
norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df <- inner_join(
  norm_mat_pca_df,
  meta %>% as_tibble(rownames = "sampleid"),
  by = "sampleid"
) %>%
  mutate(
    batch = factor(batch)
  )
# clean up space
rm(norm_mat, norm_mat_pca_df, norm_mat_pca_res)
# Statistical test between batch and PCs
kruskal.test(
  PC2 ~ batch,
  data = norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df
)

pairwise.wilcox.test(norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df$PC2, norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df$batch2, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```

```{r il10-4}
# Age diagnostic, when age is available.
if ("ages" %in% names(norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df)) {
  # Correlation between age and each PC
  cor_test_res <- cor.test(norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df$PC1, norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df$ages, method = "spearman")
  cor_test_res$p.value
}
```

```{r il10-5}
png("results/batch_raw.png", units="in", width=3.5, height=2.5, res=300)
# PCA plot
print(norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = PC1,
        y = PC2,
        color = batch
      )
    ) +
      ggtitle("PCA plot") +
      geom_point(size = 0.5) +
      stat_ellipse() +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=7),
            axis.text.y=element_text(size=6),
            plot.title = element_text(size=8),
            legend.text = element_text(size=6),
            legend.title =element_text(size=6),
            axis.title.x = element_text(size=7),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size=7)
    )
)
dev.off()
```

```{r il10-6}
  IL10$dds_norm,
  intgroup = "batch",
  returnData= F,
  pcsToUse = 1:3
)
```

# IL-10: batch-adjusted model

```{r il10-7}
#DEG
IL10_1 <- DEG(countData = countData_cytokine,
            colData = colData_cytokine, 
            design = ~ batch2 + IL10_roc, 
            condition = "IL10_roc",
            ref = "1",
            value = 0.05)
```

```{r il10-8}
# Extract variance-stabilized data
vsd <- assay(IL10_1$dds_norm)
 
# 
expr <-  limma::removeBatchEffect(vsd, IL10_1$dds_norm$batch2)

# Compute distance matrix (Euclidean or others)
d <- dist(t(expr))  # transpose: samples are rows

# Prepare metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(IL10_1$deseq))

# Run PERMANOVA / adonis test
adonis2(d ~ batch + IL10_roc, data = meta, permutations = 999)
```

```{r il10-9}

    as_tibble(rownames = "sampleid")
# Add sample metadata to the PCA table
norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df <- inner_join(
  norm_mat_pca_df,
  meta %>% as_tibble(rownames = "sampleid"),
  by = "sampleid"
) %>%
  mutate(
    batch = factor(batch)
  )
# clean up space
rm(norm_mat, norm_mat_pca_df, norm_mat_pca_res)
# Statistical test between batch and PCs
kruskal.test(
  PC2 ~ batch,
  data = norm_mat_pca_w_meta_df
)
```

# IL-10: batch- and stage-adjusted model

```{r il10-14}
#DEG
IL10_2 <- DEG(countData = countData_cytokine,
            colData = colData_cytokine, 
            design = ~ batch2+ PS + IL10_roc, 
            condition = "IL10_roc",
            ref = "1",
            value = 0.05)
```

```{r il10-15}
normalized_counts <- counts(IL10_2$deseq, normalized = TRUE)
norm_count <- as.data.frame(normalized_counts)
norm_count$ensembl <- rownames(norm_count)
```

```{r il10-16}
# Filter significant DEGs and prepare matrix
res_df_sig <- 
  IL10_2$df_sig %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
  inner_join(norm_count, by = c("ensembl" = "ensembl"))
```

```{r il10-17}
# Select expression columns by sample IDs instead of fixed positions.
rownames(res_df_sig) <- res_df_sig$ensembl
res_df_sig <- as.matrix(res_df_sig[, colData_cytokine$id, drop = FALSE])
```

```{r il10-18}
# Add a bar on top of the heatmap to identify the conditions or groups of samples

  HeatmapAnnotation(Condition = as.factor(colData_cytokine$IL10_roc),
                    
                    # Select color per each condition
                    col = list(Condition = c("1" = "orchid3", 
                                             "2" = "aquamarine")), 
                    
                    # color of the border
                    gp = gpar(col = "gray70"),
                    
                    # Show or hide the annotation name

                    annotation_legend_param = list(
                      Condition = list(direction = "vertical",

                                       legend_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                                       nrow = 1)))
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2,0,2), c("navy", "white","red"))
col_fun(seq(-2,2))
```

# TNF-alpha analysis

```{r tnfa-1}
#DEG
TNFa <- DEG(countData = countData_cytokine,
            colData = colData_cytokine, 
            design = ~ TNFa_roc, 
            condition = "TNFa_roc",
            ref = "1",
            value = 0.05)
```

```{r tnfa-2}
# Extract variance-stabilized data
expr <- assay(TNFa$dds_norm)

# Compute distance matrix (Euclidean or others)
d <- dist(t(expr))  # transpose: samples are rows

# Prepare metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(TNFa$dds_norm))

# Run PERMANOVA / adonis test
adonis2(d ~ batch2 + TNFa_roc, data = meta, permutations = 999)
```

```{r tnfa-3}
#DEG
TNFa_2 <- DEG(countData = countData_cytokine,
            colData = colData_cytokine, 
            design = ~ batch2 + PS + TNFa_roc, 
            condition = "TNFa_roc",
            ref = "1",
            value = 0.05)
```

```{r tnfa-4}
png("results/Volplot_TNFs_batch_PS.png", units="in", width=3.5, height=3, res=300)
print(volcano(TNFa_2, "Volcano Plot - TNF-α")
)
dev.off()
```

```{r tnfa-5}
# Exploratory ORA: gene-selection adjusted P < 0.6.
ORA_TNFa_2 <- ORA(TNFa_2, 0.6, 0)
```
